exception_requirements: finding_type, finding_id, severity, and target must exactly match a normalized finding
reason, owner, and ticket must be non-empty
expires_on must be a future ISO-8601 date
wildcards and expired exceptions are prohibited
notes: Blocking policy for explicitly authorized, digest-pinned application images. Do not copy the intentionally vulnerable training-image report-only switch into this workflow. A PASS is limited to configured scanner/policy coverage and is not a general security certification.
